channel.description: Latest articles from Business Insider Nederland (businessinsider.nl)

item.title: How I became the OG Hooters Girl. It was a rough start, but I have zero regrets now.
item.description: Lynne Austin was working as a telephone operator doing bikini contests as a side gig when she was approach with an opportunity that changed her life.

item.title: The history of Elon Musk and Sam Altman's relationship and feuds, which date back to the early days of OpenAI
item.description: Elon Musk and Sam Altman, who cofounded OpenAI together but today lead rival firms, have a stormy relationship.

item.title: I wanted a big festive tree this year. I wasn't expecting the $370 price tag at our local tree lot.
item.description: I went Christmas tree shopping with my teens and was stunned by a $370 price tag. It sent me back to my childhood and our tiny cheap recycled tree.

item.title: My dad died unexpectedly. It taught me that I needed to plan for my funeral ahead of time.
item.description: I never thought I'd plan my dad's funeral so soon. His death showed me why preparing for the inevitable brings comfort, not fear.

item.title: My 3 kids all need very different parenting styles from me. Being fair doesn't mean being the same.
item.description: A one-size-fits-all approach doesn't work for parenting. Over 20 years, I've learned my kids all respond to different styles.

item.title: Dick Van Dyke is 100 years old. Here are his 3 tips for living a long life.
item.description: Dick Van Dyke , who celebrated his 100th on Saturday, hasn't shied away from sharing his advice for a long, healthy life.

item.title: Microsoft AI CEO Mustafa Suleyman says he won't match Meta's high-flying pay packages
item.description: Companies like Meta are offering huge pay packages for top AI talent. Microsoft AI CEO Mustafa Suleyman, however, says he isn't giving in to the pressure.

item.title: Elon Musk just hit Sam Altman with an $800 billion counterpunch
item.description: OpenAI overtook SpaceX as the most valuable private company. SpaceX could soon reclaim the title. It's the latest in the rivalry between Musk and Altman.

item.title: Figure AI CEO says over 170,000 people have applied to his robot company in the last 3 years. He hired fewer than 500.
item.description: Figure AI CEO Brett Adcock said on X that his company reviewed 176,000 resumes but most of them were "slop." Less than 450 people were hired, he said.

item.title: Rivian's autonomy chief says lidar is 'very affordable' and a 'no-brainer' decision
item.description: Rivian's autonomy chief James Philbin told Business Insider that the cost of lidar, a sensor that can be found in robotaxis, is no longer expensive.
